subtitle: Behind the scenes of TEB RUN: how a solo developer built a pseudo-3D arcade racer in TypeScript and Canvas 2D, with no engine.

posts.title: 282 Commits to the Sunset: Building an 80s Arcade Racer in Four Days with Claude Code
posts.description: How a solo developer built TEB RUN, a zero-dependency browser racer with a road that splits in two, in 282 commits: specs, parallel agents, procedural fallbacks and getting the rights right.
